description: This Java source file defines the class DefaultCardStreamAnimator, which extends CardStreamAnimator and provides various animation methods for card stream UI elements, including appearing, disappearing, swipe in, and swipe out animations, utilizing Android's ObjectAnimator and PropertyValuesHolder.

classes.name: DefaultCardStreamAnimator
classes.description: A class that provides animated transitions for card stream UI elements, including appearing, disappearing, and swipe animations, tailored for different API levels.

methods.name: getDisappearingAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator that animates the disappearance of a card, fading out and rotating.

methods.name: getAppearingAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator that animates the appearance of a card, fading in and translating vertically.

methods.name: getInitalAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator for the initial animation of a card, with partial opacity and rotation.

methods.name: getSwipeInAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator that animates a card being swiped in, with bounce effect.

methods.name: getSwipeOutAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator that animates a card being swiped out, fading and translating off-screen.
